component.name: roobuilder
component.summary: Vala and Javascript IDE - for building Vala Desktop applications and Web Javascript

description.p: It's a cross between Glade / Visual Studio - the idea is that most 'action' code for an application is actually quite simple - so entering the code on the event handlers for an widget makes the proximity of code to action better.
This idea is applied to the Vala based Gtk applications, along with the Javascript based Roo web applications that this application is used to build and develop.
Features Wishlist - Random list of ideas to add - I regulary add these in totally random order. (see the url / wishlist)
